prompts.prompt: Draw ONE complete isolated static 2D cutout of Loo Loo, the red apple-costumed theme park mascot from Helluva Boss, strictly based on the mascot in these three official episode reference frames. Reference 1 is the high wide shot that shows the entire mascot including both red shoes. References 2 and 3 show his face, leaf, hat, arms, glove construction and black legs more clearly. Isolate ONLY this mascot; no other characters, no park, no text, no logo, no platform. A nearly round tall RED APPLE forms the whole body and face; there is no separate human torso and no neck. Bright green scalloped apple-cap across the crown, a short dark stem, a single bright green leaf, and the small black top hat with a red band seen behind the leaf. Two huge round black eyes with pale yellow surrounds and small wedge highlights, round red cheeks, a very broad pale yellow grinning mouth with thin black stitched-looking tooth separators and a prominent black missing upper tooth. Short thin flexible black arms emerge from each side of the apple, red four-fingered padded mascot gloves with darker red round cuffs. Two thin BLACK legs extend below the apple and end in simple RED rounded mascot shoes, as in the official wide shot. Do not add green boots or white socks. Friendly slightly awkward neutral standing stance, both legs planted visibly apart, one gloved hand relaxed at side and one held in a small welcoming wave. Preserve the compact round silhouette and face construction from the attached official source. Clean bold dark outline and restrained flat cel shading, crisp readable cartoon game asset. Use a portrait canvas, scale the complete figure to about 76 percent of canvas height with at least 10 percent empty transparent margin above the leaf and below both soles and around both hands. GENUINE transparent alpha background, no floor, no cast shadow, no ambient glow, no smoke, no border, no lettering. Single full-body drawing only, not an animation or sprite sheet.

Create ONE complete isolated static 2D cutout of Crymini, specifically the 2017 early Hazbin Hotel concept incarnation shown on the RIGHT of the first two attached images from Vivziepop's official Teenager speedpainting. Keep the black studded collar and the red-and-black punk tunic top with its small white skull graphic, crossed arms with black forearm gloves and pale small hands. Preserve the distinctive asymmetrical legs exactly as shown: viewer-left leg dark black with pale diagonal slashes at the upper thigh, viewer-right leg pale cream with a column of dark magenta spots, slim pointed dark foot tips. Full figure including all hair, ear tips, tail tip and both feet, centered on a portrait canvas, occupying no more than 78 percent of canvas height with generous clear margins. TRUE transparent alpha background. No floor, shadow, glow, scene, border, text, logo or additional figures. One single static drawing, no animation and no sprite sheet.
